Maya L: Heads up — marketing wants to go live with the launch post Mon 5/12 09:00 PT. Need final changelog URL, docs anchor, and confirmation of rollout windows + any embargo constraints. cc @Sam T @Oliver D @Ravi S
Sam T: I'll push the changelog tonight and share the permalink. Rollout plan: hosted -> dedicated -> private, with 20m monitoring windows between stages. I'll paste exact timestamps after I confirm capacity checks.
Oliver D: Docs PR is queued: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/490. Canonical anchor will be /releases/2-2. Adding a migration snippet for the client and a short note about behavior changes in embeddings quantization.
Ravi S: For webinars — Emily asked for a 3-bullet tech highlight and a benchmark line comparing P95 latency to previous release. Can we provide the P95 number?
Sam T: Preliminary P95 for redwood-large-v2 on 8xA10G is ~210ms for 128 tokens under our canary profile. I'll produce the verified number by tomorrow morning.
Maya L: Good. Also need the lead routing link and the sales-assignment tag so web form routes to AE pool.
Oliver D: SalesOps has a form: https://crm.redwood.ai/forms/launch-5-12 which uses tag `ae_pool_release_may12` — include that in the post and webinar landing page.
Maya L: Embargo? Are we cleared to keep staging links internal until publish?
Sam T: Embargo confirmed. No external sharing of staging PRs. We'll broadcast the live release URLs to #marketing once the release job completes.
deploy-bot: Release job scheduled for 1779133200 (Mon May 12 09:00:00 PT). Will update status in #eng-releases when done.
Maya L: I'll post the marketing draft in #marketing-drafts for a 2-hour review window before publish. Tagging @Ravi S for the benchmark copy.
Ravi S: I'll prepare the benchmark blurb and a short graph image alt text.
Sam T: Once draft is up ping me, I'll paste the changelog permalink and verify the release job health.
Maya L: Thanks team — aiming for smooth launch :rocket:
